description: Templates for synthetic caller turns (#7). Each scenario fixes department, urgency and safety_hazard, using the same conventions as data/seed/seed.jsonl (see data/README.md). The generator samples a scenario, a location form, a mood and the flags, and asks the language model only to put it into spoken Kannada.

urgency_meaning.routine: a minor nuisance or a question; nothing gets worse if it waits
urgency_meaning.soon: a service has been missing or broken for days and needs fixing soon
urgency_meaning.urgent: damage is spreading or a risk is building up and should be handled today
urgency_meaning.emergency: someone may get hurt right now

water.en: no water supply in the caller's area for a few days
water comes at very low pressure and the overhead tank never fills
water comes at odd hours, for example at midnight, and only for a short time
a water pipe has burst on the road and clean water is being wasted
tap water is coming out dirty, reddish or smelly
drain water is mixing into the drinking water and people at home have fallen sick
the water tanker the corporation promised has not come
a public tap or valve is leaking all day and water is wasted

sewage-drainage.en: the street drain has not been cleaned for a long time and mosquitoes have increased
a blocked drain is overflowing onto the road with a terrible stink
sewage from a blocked drain is coming into the caller's house
a manhole on the road has no lid and is wide open
the drain slab is broken and someone could fall in
every time it rains the road fills with water and vehicles cannot pass
the underground drainage line keeps getting choked in the same place
bad smell from the drain in front of the house, otherwise flowing

solid-waste.en: the garbage van has not come to the street for many days
the dustbin is full and garbage is spilling onto the road
someone has set a garbage heap on fire and there is a lot of smoke
a dead animal has been lying on the road for days
construction debris was dumped by the roadside at night
garbage collectors mix the segregated wet and dry waste together
garbage collectors ask for extra money to take the garbage
a big garbage heap near houses has started to rot and smell

roads.en: a big pothole on the road; a two-wheeler rider fell yesterday
the road was dug up for work and left unfinished for weeks
the whole road surface is badly damaged
shopkeepers have put their goods on the footpath and there is no space to walk
a speed breaker has no paint and cannot be seen at night
a tree has fallen and blocked the whole road; even an ambulance cannot pass
a pothole filled with rainwater cannot be seen and vehicles keep hitting it
the caller asks when the road in their area will be asphalted

streetlights.en: the street light has not come on for weeks and the street is dark at night
the street light stays on during the day and electricity is wasted
a wire has fallen from the light pole and is sparking
a light pole is bent and about to fall where children play
several street lights in a row are off and women are afraid to walk at night
the street light keeps flickering on and off
the light pole's junction box is open with wires showing at hand height

stray-animals.en: a stray dog bit a child and is still roaming there
stray dogs have increased and bark all night
a pack of stray dogs chases two-wheelers and children
cattle lie in the middle of the road and could cause an accident
monkeys get into houses and damage things
a snake has come into the caller's compound
an injured stray dog is lying by the road

other.en: the play equipment in the park is broken and children could get hurt
the caller asks when mosquito fogging will be done in their area
a neighbour seems to be constructing a building without permission
the public toilet in the area is locked or very dirty
the caller asks how to pay property tax or get a trade licence

out_of_scope.en: a fight is going on near the caller's house and people are hitting each other
a family member has chest pain and they need an ambulance
the electricity bill is far too high and they want to complain about it
they want to link their ration card or apply for a new one
the neighbours built a wall on the caller's land and they want to file a complaint against them
someone's bike was stolen from outside the house
the power has been cut at home since morning

fake_id_note: Indian mobile numbers start with 6-9 and Aadhaar numbers never start with 0 or 1, so none of these can belong to anyone.
ward_aliases_note: Short forms that point to one ward. Hosapura has one hospital (Gandhinagar's government hospital), so the seed set labels a bare 'hospital' as w04 (seed-014).
